d.seg: मैं आपको तीन सौ रुपए दूंगा चार सौ रुपए दूंगा पाँच सौ रुपए दूंगा
d.tr: I will give you 300 rupees, 400 rupees, 500 rupees.
d.ctx: The user is offering money to the expert in exchange for sexual services. The expert reacts defensively.
d.j: The user is offering money for sexual services, which matches the strong case for SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: क्यों तीन सौ रुपए में आप बॉडी दिखा रहे हो सबको
d.tr: Why are you showing your body to everyone for 300 rupees?
d.ctx: The user is accusing the expert of showing her body for money. The expert denies this and gets angry.
d.j: The user is accusing the expert of showing her body, which matches the strong case for Explicit-Flirting.

d.seg: देखो अगर आपने व्हाट्सएप वीडियो कॉल बोला
d.tr: Look, if you mentioned WhatsApp video call
d.ctx: The user is referencing a previous mention of WhatsApp. The expert responds by defending herself against the accusation of sexual intent.
d.j: The user is referencing a proposal to move to WhatsApp, which matches the strong case for PlatformMove.
